profile.role_note: An Electro carry. Most of his damage in the Intuition state counts as Resonance Liberation DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Skip his reruns. Newer DPS like Augusta have passed his kit by. If you already own him — he was free in version 1.2 — he is still a workable Electro carry, and worth building.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Verity's Handle + 5-piece Void Thunder in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Nightmare: Thundering Mephis in the main slot. Use Crit Rate or Crit DMG on the 4-cost. Use two Electro DMG pieces on the 3-costs. Use ATK% on the 1-costs. In substats, stack Crit, Energy Regen, and Resonance Liberation DMG.

ranked_weapons.name: Verity's Handle
ranked_weapons.note: His signature. It gives 12% Attribute DMG, plus 48% Resonance Liberation DMG after his Liberation. Resonance Skill casts can extend that. It has a Crit Rate substat. Best in slot by far — though Prydwen's current numbers rank Iuno's signature above it.

ranked_weapons.name: Moongazer's Sigil
ranked_weapons.note: A newer 5-star. ATK%, plus Resonance Liberation DMG on Intro and Liberation, and DEF-ignore stacks.

ranked_weapons.name: Abyss Surges
ranked_weapons.note: A standard-banner 5-star stat stick. It gives Energy Regen, plus Basic Attack and Resonance Skill DMG bonuses. Newer 5-stars outclass it.

ranked_weapons.name: Stonard
ranked_weapons.note: The best 4-star option. Casting his Resonance Skill grants an 18% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 15s.

build.weapon_filler_note: S5 Gauntlets of Night works as a free stand-in. Marcato speeds up Concerto Energy generation. Neither matches a 5-star.

echo_sets.name: Void Thunder
echo_sets.note: Still his best set in 3.7, per Game8. It stacks Electro DMG on Heavy Attacks and Resonance Skills. Nightmare: Thundering Mephis adds Electro and Liberation DMG, without needing its Echo Skill.

echo_sets.name: Void Thunder + Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: An early-game stand-in, while you farm a full 5-pc Void Thunder set.

stat_priorities.note: Pick whichever keeps your Crit Rate to Crit DMG ratio near 1:2. Target 60%+ Crit Rate and 150%+ Crit DMG.
Double Electro DMG is optimal; ATK% is a weaker substitute.
ATK% on both; his kit scales with ATK.

build.energy_regen_target: No dedicated target in current guides; Energy Regen sits third in substat priority for rotation comfort.

teams.name: Premium: Xiangli Yao + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Xiangli Yao
members.note: Hypercarry whose Intuition-state attacks count as Resonance Liberation DMG.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: Liberation and Outro hand out All DMG and Resonance Liberation DMG buffs; also boosts Tune Break DMG.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Syntony Field sustain with interruption resistance, faster Off-Tune Buildup, enemy DMG-taken increase, and teamwide All DMG amp.

teams.rotation: Mornye opens. She sets up her Syntony Field healing and Tune Break support. Lynae builds her Liberation, then Outros into Xiangli Yao. He takes a long on-field window: Resonance Skill, Basic Attacks to build stacks, Resonance Liberation, then his enhanced Resonance Skill combo. He does all of it while Lynae's and Mornye's buffs are active.

teams.name: Alternative: Xiangli Yao + Yinlin + Shorekeeper

members.name: Xiangli Yao
members.note: Classic Electro hypercarry; benefits enormously from Yinlin's coordinated-attack support kit.

members.name: Yinlin
members.note: Coordinated attacks; Outro grants 20% Electro DMG and 25% Resonance Liberation DMG — tailor-made for his kit.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Universal Crit and damage buffs plus healing; fits literally any DPS.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm and builds energy. Yinlin runs her full combo and Outros into Xiangli Yao, with her Electro and Resonance Liberation buffs. Xiangli Yao runs his full Intuition combo: Resonance Skill, Basics, Liberation, and his enhanced skill. Then the rotation loops.

teams.name: Budget: Xiangli Yao + Sanhua + Verina

members.name: Xiangli Yao
members.note: Hypercarry; most damage comes from his Liberation-scaling Intuition state.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Free 4-star quick-swap sub-DPS; Outro grants 38% Basic Attack DMG for his stack-building phase.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Free universal healer and buffer; Outro deepens the whole team's DMG.

teams.rotation: Verina buffs and heals, then swaps out. Sanhua quick-swaps in to apply her Outro's Basic Attack DMG buff. Then Xiangli Yao takes his full on-field burst window as the carry.

tier_badge.label: Solid but powercrept
tier_badge.note: Most current lists place him at A, including the endgame ranks. Two others rank him B. Newer DPS like Augusta outclass him.

sequences.verdict: S0 is a complete, free DPS. Aim for S2. Stop at S3 for value. S6 is whales only.

pull_path.why: Free unit whose full Intuition combo works at S0.
+30% Crit DMG for 8s on skill or Liberation — guildjen's starting point.
+63% Resonance Skill DMG for 24s after Liberation — both guides call it the value stop.
+76% Law of Reigns multiplier — the finisher nuke.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Get the signature Verity's Handle before S1. It is his Liberation-boosting engine. S0 plus the signature beats chasing S1.
